knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Hand hygiene is performed at the facility's specified transitions, including after glove removal and before touching clean stock. A single shift-start or visible-dirt rule is not sufficient.
Protection is selected from the product safety data sheet and facility task assessment. Habit or trolley position is not a basis for selection.
The task stops and the facility exposure procedure is followed with a same-shift report. A cleaner does not judge a splash minor and carry on.

practicalCriteria: Given three task cards and their safety data sheets, the learner selects protective equipment for each and gives the reason from the data sheet.
In a supervised setting, the learner removes gloves, performs hand hygiene and puts on new gloves before touching a clean supply, without contaminating clean stock.
Given a simulated splash on broken skin, the learner stops the task, names the exposure steps in order, and identifies the person to notify.
passRule: Practical competence requires facility-observed assessment against the criteria above. A pass on the knowledge checks is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Signed protective equipment selection sheet for three tasks
Observation record of the donning, doffing and hand hygiene sequence
Observation note of the simulated exposure response
stopWorkCriteria: Learner begins a task without the protection specified on the safety data sheet
Learner handles a sharp with bare or gloved hands
Learner continues work after an exposure without following the facility procedure
